name: Saltmarsh Roast
purpose: Online store for a small coastal coffee roaster: browse a catalog of roasted coffees with photos and prices, build a cart, check out as a guest, and revisit past orders.

entities.name: Order
relationships: optionally belongs to a customer account
stores customer email for guest checkout
snapshots shipping name and address for physical fulfillment

entities.name: OrderItem
relationships: snapshots name, unit price, quantity at purchase time

entities.name: CustomerAccount
relationships: optional — guest checkout doesn't require one

workflows.name: Browse catalog
workflows.description: Visitor sees products with photos, roast profile, origin, tasting notes, and price.

workflows.name: Add to cart
workflows.description: Visitor adds quantities to a cart without an account.

workflows.name: Checkout
workflows.description: Guest checkout collects an email and a shipping address; order completes through the local test simulator in the preview.

workflows.name: View past orders
workflows.description: Signed-in customers see their order history; guests reach their receipt via a signed expiring access link.

workflows.name: Admin manage store
workflows.description: Admin creates/edits products and views orders including shipping addresses.

seed_demo: Six coffees with roast names, origins, roast levels, tasting notes, weights, prices, and photos; a couple of seeded orders for the demo account so order history is visible.
